value.rationale: The pair 1+e_1±e_3 is the classical minimal three-term Hardy--Littlewood counterexample. A sharp finite-grid transition at character order five is a natural structural discretization result, and the uniform positive gap is useful in finite-group and sampling arguments rather than being an arbitrary small-modulus census.
